# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| code-summary: "Load packages"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
packages <- c("amt", "lubridate",
              "terra", "sf",
              "beepr", "tictoc",
              "leaflet", "tidyterra")
walk(packages, require, character.only = T)

```

# Import GPS tracking data

```{r}

pig_all_steps <- read_csv("data/pig_all_steps_20261015.csv")

# Convert timezone after import (resets to GMT)
pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% 
  mutate(
    t1_  = with_tz(t1_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"),
    t2_ = with_tz(t2_, tzone = "Australia/Darwin"), 
    hour = hour(t1_) + minute(t1_)/60 + second(t1_)/3600,
    hour_round = hour(t1_),
    month = month(t1_),
    season = case_when(month %in% c(11,12, 1, 2, 3, 4) ~ "wet",
                       month %in% seq(5,10) ~ "dry")
    )

```

## Plot the pig data

```{r}

# plot the data spatially coloured by ID
pig_all_steps %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x1_, y = y1_, colour = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

### Plot with east alligator subset

```{r}

pig_all_steps %>% 
  filter(x1_ > -170000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x1_, y = y1_, colour = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% filter(x1_ > -170000)

paste0("There are ", nrow(pig_all_steps), " pig locations from ", length(unique(pig_all_steps$name)), " individuals in the subset.")

```

## Use leaflet to plot the data

```{r}
#| label: leaflet-map
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# convert to an sf object (x1_/y1_ are in GDA94 / GA Lambert, EPSG:3112)
# and reproject to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for leaflet
pig_all_steps_sf <- pig_all_steps %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

pal <- colorFactor(viridisLite::viridis(n_distinct(pig_all_steps_sf$name), option = "H"),
                    domain = pig_all_steps_sf$name)

# addCircleMarkers() draws one SVG element per point, and there are ~246k of
# them, which locks up the browser (and the VS Code webview in particular).
# Thin the points for display and draw them with WebGL via leafgl instead.
pig_map_pts <- pig_all_steps_sf %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  slice(seq(1, n(), by = 1)) %>% # every ith fix per pig
  ungroup()

# Break each pig's track wherever the gap between fixes is longer than this,
# so the lines don't jump across periods with no data
max_gap_hours <- 3

pig_map_pts <- pig_map_pts %>%
  arrange(name, t1_) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(new_seg = is.na(lag(t1_)) |
           difftime(t1_, lag(t1_), units = "hours") > max_gap_hours,
         seg = cumsum(new_seg)) %>%
  ungroup()

# one line per pig per continuous run of fixes
pig_map_lines <- pig_map_pts %>%
  group_by(name, seg) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE, .groups = "drop") %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

# Data for the time slider, sorted by time. Coordinates are stored as integers
# (degrees * 1e5, ~1 m) and times as seconds since the first fix, which keeps
# the JSON embedded in the html much smaller
pig_levels <- sort(unique(pig_map_pts$name))
t0 <- min(pig_map_pts$t1_)
pig_time <- pig_map_pts %>% arrange(t1_)
pig_time_xy <- st_coordinates(pig_time)

pig_time_data <- list(
  lng = as.integer(round(pig_time_xy[, "X"] * 1e5)),
  lat = as.integer(round(pig_time_xy[, "Y"] * 1e5)),
  t = as.integer(round(as.numeric(difftime(pig_time$t1_, t0, units = "secs")))),
  pig = match(pig_time$name, pig_levels) - 1L,
  brk = as.integer(pig_time$new_seg),
  pigs = pig_levels,
  cols = pal(pig_levels),
  t0 = as.numeric(t0),
  step = 30 * 60, # slider step (s), matching the 30 min fix rate
  max_gap = max_gap_hours * 3600
)

# The time slider is a custom canvas layer (the leaftime package draws every
# feature as SVG, which has the same problem as addCircleMarkers). Each redraw
# only draws the fixes inside the current time window: the trail of each pig
# as a line plus small points, and its latest fix as a large point (only if
# that fix is within max_gap_hours of the slider time).
pig_time_js <- r"--[
function(el, x, d) {
  var map = this;
  var n = d.t.length, npig = d.pigs.length, STEP = d.step;
  var t = d.t, pig = d.pig, brk = d.brk;
  var lat = new Float64Array(n), lng = new Float64Array(n);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { lat[i] = d.lat[i] / 1e5; lng[i] = d.lng[i] / 1e5; }
  var tMax = Math.ceil(t[n - 1] / STEP) * STEP;
  var state = { cur: 86400, win: 86400, timer: null };

  // first index with t >= v
  function lowerBound(v) {
    var a = 0, b = n;
    while (a < b) { var m = (a + b) >> 1; if (t[m] < v) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    return a;
  }

  function fmt(s) {
    return new Date((d.t0 + s) * 1000).toLocaleString('en-AU', {
      timeZone: 'Australia/Darwin', day: '2-digit', month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
  }

  var TimeLayer = L.Layer.extend({
    onAdd: function(m) {
      this._canvas = L.DomUtil.create('canvas', 'leaflet-zoom-hide');
      this._canvas.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      m.getPanes().overlayPane.appendChild(this._canvas);
      m.on('moveend resize', this._reset, this);
      this._reset();
    },
    onRemove: function(m) {
      L.DomUtil.remove(this._canvas);
      m.off('moveend resize', this._reset, this);
    },
    _reset: function() {
      var size = map.getSize(), r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1, c = this._canvas;
      L.DomUtil.setPosition(c, map.containerPointToLayerPoint([0, 0]));
      c.width = size.x * r; c.height = size.y * r;
      c.style.width = size.x + 'px'; c.style.height = size.y + 'px';
      this.redraw();
    },
    redraw: function() {
      var c = this._canvas, ctx = c.getContext('2d'), r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      ctx.setTransform(r, 0, 0, r, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width / r, c.height / r);

      var lo = lowerBound(state.cur - state.win), hi = lowerBound(state.cur + 1);
      var px = new Float32Array(hi - lo), py = new Float32Array(hi - lo);
      var byPig = [], i, j, k, q, idx;
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) byPig.push([]);
      for (i = lo; i < hi; i++) {
        var p = map.latLngToContainerPoint([lat[i], lng[i]]);
        px[i - lo] = p.x; py[i - lo] = p.y;
        byPig[pig[i]].push(i);
      }

      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) {
        idx = byPig[k];
        if (!idx.length) continue;
        ctx.strokeStyle = d.cols[k]; ctx.fillStyle = d.cols[k];
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (j = 0; j < idx.length; j++) {
          q = idx[j] - lo;
          if (j === 0 || brk[idx[j]]) ctx.moveTo(px[q], py[q]); else ctx.lineTo(px[q], py[q]);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (j = 0; j < idx.length; j++) {
          q = idx[j] - lo;
          ctx.moveTo(px[q] + 2.5, py[q]); ctx.arc(px[q], py[q], 2.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        }
        ctx.fill();
      }

      ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      for (k = 0; k < npig; k++) {
        idx = byPig[k];
        if (!idx.length) continue;
        i = idx[idx.length - 1];
        if (state.cur - t[i] > d.max_gap) continue;
        q = i - lo;
        ctx.fillStyle = d.cols[k];
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px[q], py[q], 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  });

  var layer = new TimeLayer().addTo(map);

  var ctrl = L.control({ position: 'bottomleft' });
  ctrl.onAdd = function() {
    var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
    div.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;padding:6px 10px;font:12px/1.5 sans-serif;';
    div.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-play" style="width:30px">&#9654;</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-back" title="Back 30 min">&#8249;</button>' +
        '<input type="range" class="pt-slider" min="0" max="' + tMax + '" step="' + STEP +
          '" value="' + state.cur + '" style="width:420px">' +
        '<button type="button" class="pt-fwd" title="Forward 30 min">&#8250;</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:4px">' +
        '<span class="pt-label" style="min-width:290px"></span>' +
        'Trail <select class="pt-win">' +
          '<option value="21600">6 hours</option>' +
          '<option value="86400" selected>1 day</option>' +
          '<option value="259200">3 days</option>' +
          '<option value="604800">1 week</option>' +
          '<option value="2592000">30 days</option>' +
          '<option value="Infinity">All to date</option>' +
        '</select>' +
        'Speed <select class="pt-speed">' +
          '<option value="1800">30 min/s</option>' +
          '<option value="3600">1 hour/s</option>' +
          '<option value="10800">3 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="21600">6 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="43200">12 hours/s</option>' +
          '<option value="86400" selected>1 day/s</option>' +
          '<option value="259200">3 days/s</option>' +
          '<option value="604800">1 week/s</option>' +
        '</select>' +
      '</div>';
    L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
    L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
    return div;
  };
  ctrl.addTo(map);

  var div = ctrl.getContainer();
  var slider = div.querySelector('.pt-slider'), label = div.querySelector('.pt-label');
  var playBtn = div.querySelector('.pt-play'), win = div.querySelector('.pt-win');
  var speed = div.querySelector('.pt-speed');

  function update() {
    slider.value = state.cur;
    label.textContent = fmt(Math.max(0, state.cur - state.win)) + '  –  ' + fmt(state.cur);
    layer.redraw();
  }
  function stop() {
    clearInterval(state.timer); state.timer = null; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;';
  }

  // Playback speed is in seconds of data per real second. Each tick advances a
  // whole number of slider steps, with at most 10 ticks per second, so slow
  // speeds tick less often rather than moving by part of a step
  function start() {
    var rate = Number(speed.value);
    var k = Math.max(1, Math.round(rate / 10 / STEP));
    state.timer = setInterval(function() {
      state.cur = Math.min(state.cur + k * STEP, tMax);
      update();
      if (state.cur >= tMax) stop();
    }, 1000 * k * STEP / rate);
  }
  function stepBy(nSteps) {
    state.cur = Math.min(Math.max(state.cur + nSteps * STEP, 0), tMax);
    update();
  }

  slider.addEventListener('input', function() { state.cur = +slider.value; update(); });
  win.addEventListener('change', function() { state.win = Number(win.value); update(); });
  speed.addEventListener('change', function() {
    if (state.timer) { clearInterval(state.timer); start(); }
  });
  div.querySelector('.pt-back').addEventListener('click', function() { stepBy(-1); });
  div.querySelector('.pt-fwd').addEventListener('click', function() { stepBy(1); });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (state.timer) { stop(); return; }
    if (state.cur >= tMax) state.cur = 0;
    playBtn.innerHTML = '&#10074;&#10074;';
    start();
  });

  update();
}
]--"

pig_map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  leafgl::addGlPolylines(data = pig_map_lines,
                         color = pal(pig_map_lines$name),
                         opacity = 0.6,
                         weight = 1.5,
                         group = "All tracks") %>%
  leafgl::addGlPoints(data = pig_map_pts,
                      fillColor = pal(pig_map_pts$name),
                      fillOpacity = 0.75,
                      radius = 5,
                      popup = paste0("ID: ", pig_map_pts$name,
                                     "<br>Time: ", pig_map_pts$t1_),
                      group = "All fixes") %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft",
              options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE)) %>%
  addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal,
            values = pig_map_pts$name, title = "Pig ID") %>%
  # the full tracks and fixes are off by default so the time slider layer is
  # readable; tick them on in the layers control
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("All tracks", "All fixes"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  hideGroup(c("All tracks", "All fixes")) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(pig_time_js, data = pig_time_data)

# The VS Code htmlwidget viewer struggles with large maps, so when working
# interactively write the map out and open it in the system browser. When the
# document is rendered, the widget is printed inline as usual.
if (interactive()) {
  map_file <- file.path("outputs", "pig_map.html") #tempdir()
  # selfcontained = FALSE writes a sibling _files/ folder, which avoids needing
  # pandoc on the path and is much faster to write for a map this size
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(pig_map, map_file, selfcontained = TRUE)
  utils::browseURL(map_file)
} else {
  pig_map
}

```

## Plot a timelime of the GPS data collection

```{r}

pig_all_steps %>% #filter(name != "Unknown1") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = t1_, y = name, colour = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Pig ID") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

ggsave("outputs/east_alligator_pig_timeline.png", 
       width = 250, height = 150, units = "mm", scale = 0.75, dpi = 600)

```

## Create a bounding box around the pig data to crop the other layers by

```{r}

pig_all_steps_sf

pig_aoi <- st_bbox(pig_all_steps_sf) %>% 
  st_as_sfc() %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 3112) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 2500) %>%
  st_bbox() %>% # the buffer creates curved corners so we need to get the bounding box of the buffered area
  st_as_sfc()

# save the bounding box as a shapefile
pig_aoi %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_write("mapping/pig_aoi_wgs84.geojson", driver = "GeoJSON", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```

### Use the temperature to check the timezone 

Assuming hotter during the middle hours.

```{r}

# by pig ID
pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = temp, colour = name, fill = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = T) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# by the month of the year
pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = temp, colour = as.factor(month), fill = as.factor(month))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = T) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d("Month") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d("Month") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# by season
pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = temp, colour = season, fill = season)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = T) +
  # scale_colour_viridis_d("Season") +
  # scale_fill_viridis_d("Season") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

### Step length and turning angle distributions

```{r}
  geom_histogram(fill = "orange", colour = "black", binwidth = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous("Step length (m)", limits = c(0, 500)) +

  filter(dt_hour < 0.75) %>% # keep the half-hour locations
```

### Binning instead of using a smooth

```{r}

bin_width <- 0.5  # hours

bin_means <- pig_all_steps %>%
  mutate(bin = floor(hour / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width / 2) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sl = mean(sl_, na.rm = TRUE),
    se      = sd(sl_, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(sl_))),
    q25     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75     = quantile(sl_, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = sum(!is.na(sl_)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = sl_)) +
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  
    # mean with error bar
  geom_errorbar(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                aes(x = bin, ymin = mean_sl - se, ymax = mean_sl + se),
                width = bin_width * 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = bin, y = mean_sl), colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(x = bin, y = mean_sl), colour = "black", size = 2) +

  #   # median and quartiles
  # geom_line(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #           aes(x = bin, y = q25), colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_line(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #           aes(x = bin, y = q50), colour = "black") +
  # geom_line(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #           aes(x = bin, y = q75), colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  # geom_point(data = bin_means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #            aes(x = bin, y = q50), colour = "black", size = 2) +
  
  scale_y_continuous("Step length (m)", limits = c(0, 500)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


## By ID

```{r}

n_names <- n_distinct(pig_all_steps$name)
viridis_cols <- viridisLite::viridis(n_names)

pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = hour, y = sl_, colour = name, fill = name),
              alpha = 0.15,
              method = "gam", se = T) +
  geom_smooth(data = pig_all_steps,
              aes(x = hour, y = sl_),
              method = "gam", se = T,
              alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 2, fill = "red", colour = "red") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scales::alpha(viridis_cols, 0.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis_cols) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Step length (m)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("outputs/east_alligator_hourly_step_lengths.png", 
       width = 250, height = 150, units = "mm", scale = 0.75, dpi = 600)

```

```{r}

pig_all_steps %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = sl_, colour = season, fill = season)) +
  # geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1) +
  # scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  # scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = T) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Step length (m)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```


## Gamma - all data

```{r}

sl_gamma <- fit_distr(pig_all_steps$sl_, "gamma", na.rm = TRUE)
sl_gamma

```

## Gamma - discrete periods

We will, fairly arbitrarily, split the day into 4 periods: dawn (4-8), day (8-16), dusk (16-20), night (20-4).

Note that the hour_round is the floor (from lubridate::hour), i.e. 4:50am is 4, is it is within the 4th hour.

```{r}

pig_all_steps <- pig_all_steps %>% 
  mutate(
    day_period = case_when(hour_round %in% c(4,5,6,7) ~ "dawn",
                       hour_round %in% seq(8,15) ~ "day",
                       hour_round %in% seq(16,19) ~ "dusk",
                       hour_round %in% c(20,21,22,23,0,1,2,3) ~ "night")
  )
```

### How many landcover types are there?

```{r}

unique(landcover_cropped$Veg_class)
length(unique(landcover_cropped$Veg_class))

```

### Create landcover raster layers for each landcover type

One binary (0/1) layer per vegetation class, on the same grid as the Sentinel-2
exports so that all of the covariates stack without any resampling.

```{r}
#| label: landcover-dummy

# Use the ndvi layer as the template grid (20 m, EPSG:3112) so the
# landcover layers line up cell-for-cell with the remotely sensed covariates
lc_template <- deepcopy(ndvi)
lc_template[] <- NA # keep the geometry, drop the values

# Rasterise the polygons; a character field gives a categorical raster, where
# the levels table maps the integer cell values back to the class names
landcover_rast <- rasterize(vect(landcover_cropped), lc_template,
                            field = "Veg_class")
plot(landcover_rast)
lc_levels <- levels(landcover_rast)[[1]]

```

### What frequency do they occur in the data?

```{r}

landcover_vals <- terra::extract(landcover_rast, matrix(c(pig_all_steps$x2_, pig_all_steps$y2_), ncol = 2))
pig_all_steps_covs <- bind_cols(pig_all_steps, landcover_vals) 

# pig_all_steps_covs %>%

#   theme(legend.position = "none")

pig_all_steps_covs %>%
  count(Veg_class, season) %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Veg_class, x = prop, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7,
           colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    "Season",
    values = c("wet" = "skyblue", "dry" = "orange"),
    labels = c("wet" = "Wet season", "dry" = "Dry season")) +
  scale_y_discrete("Vegetation Class") +
  scale_x_continuous("Proportion of season's locations", labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.95, 0.95),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = NA)
  )

ggsave("outputs/east_alligator_habitat_use_seasonal.png",
       width = 260, height = 150, units = "mm", scale = 0.75, dpi = 1000)

```

### Recode based on their frequency in the data

```{r}

recode_df <- data.frame(
  
  old = c("Wet Rainforest Springfed", 
          "Water", 
          "Mudflat",
          "Melaleuca Woodland", 
          "Melaleuca Open Woodland",
          "Melaleuca Open Forest", 
          "Melaleuca Closed Forest",
          "Mangrove", 
          "Grassland",
          "Floodplain Sedgeland",
          "Eucalypt Woodland", 
          "Eucalypt Open Woodland",
          "Eucalypt Open Forest", 
          "Eucalypt Closed Forest",
          "Dry Rainforest"),
  
  new = c("Dry Rainforest", 
          "Water", 
          "Mudflat",
          "Melaleuca Woodland", 
          "Melaleuca Woodland",
          "Melaleuca Open Forest", 
          "Melaleuca Closed Forest",
          "Mangrove", 
          "Floodplain Sedgeland",
          "Floodplain Sedgeland",
          "Eucalypt Woodland", 
          "Eucalypt Woodland",
          "Eucalypt Open Forest", 
          "Eucalypt Open Forest",
          "Dry Rainforest")
)

```

### Apply recode to raster

```{r}

lvls <- levels(landcover_rast)[[1]]                 # data.frame: ID, Veg_class

# left join: recode_df only covers classes seen at pig locations, but the
# raster covers the whole study area, so classes absent from recode_df$old
# would otherwise be dropped (and turn into NA) rather than passed through
lvls <- merge(lvls, recode_df, by.x = "Veg_class", by.y = "old",
              all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

lvls$new[is.na(lvls$new)] <- lvls$Veg_class[is.na(lvls$new)]

landcover_rast_merged <- deepcopy(landcover_rast)
levels(landcover_rast_merged) <- data.frame(ID = lvls$ID, Veg_class = lvls$new)
landcover_rast_merged <- droplevels(landcover_rast_merged)  # collapses duplicate labels into shared levels

freq(landcover_rast_merged)   # check the merge worked as expected
plot(landcover_rast_merged)

```

### Create dummy variables for each landcover type

```{r}

# segregate() expands the categorical raster into one 0/1 layer per class
landcover_dummy <- segregate(landcover_rast_merged, other = 0)

# segregate() names the layers by the integer category ID, so map them back to
# the class names, as snake_case so they work as covariate names downstream
names(landcover_dummy) <- lc_levels$Veg_class[
  match(as.integer(names(landcover_dummy)), lc_levels$ID)] %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
  paste0("veg_", .)

landcover_dummy

# maxnl defaults to 16, so set it explicitly or the last few classes are dropped
plot(landcover_dummy, col = c("grey90", "darkgreen"), legend = FALSE,
     maxnl = nlyr(landcover_dummy), axes = FALSE,
     mar = c(1.5, 1.5, 2, 1.5))

```

# Extract landcover values at the pig locations

```{r}

covariate_vals <- terra::extract(
  c(ndvi,
    ndwi,
    ndmi,
    landcover_rast_merged,
    landcover_dummy), 
  matrix(c(pig_all_steps$x2_, pig_all_steps$y2_), ncol = 2))
  
pig_all_steps_covs <- bind_cols(pig_all_steps, covariate_vals) 

# write to file - check that date in the filename matches the data imported at the start of the script
write_csv(pig_all_steps_covs, "data/pig_all_steps_covs_20261015.csv") 

```

```{r}
  p <- pig_all_steps_covs %>%
    filter(dt_hour < 0.75) %>% # keep the half-hour locations
    ggplot(aes(x = t1_, y = .data[[veg_var]], colour = name, fill = name)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
    scale_colour_viridis_d() +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = T) +
    labs(y = veg_var) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p)

}

```

# Subset tracking and environmental data

Given there are two clusters in the data, subset to the one that has most of the data, greatly reducing the total area needed for the spatial layers. This is particularly helpful for the AlphaEarth embeddings, which are ~4GB for the full extent.

## Subset tracking data

### Plot all of the data

```{r}

paste0("There are ", nrow(pig_all_steps_covs), " pig locations in the data.")

# plot the data spatially coloured by ID
pig_all_steps_covs %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x1_, y = y1_, colour = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

### Create bounding box

```{r}

pig_all_steps_covs_subset_sf <- pig_all_steps_covs %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x1_", "y1_"), crs = 3112)

pig_subset_aoi <- st_bbox(pig_all_steps_covs_subset_sf) %>% 
  st_as_sfc() %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 2500) %>%
  st_bbox() %>% # the buffer creates curved corners so we need to get the bounding box of the buffered area
  st_as_sfc()

# plot the data with the bounding box
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pig_subset_aoi) +
  geom_point(data = pig_all_steps_covs,
             aes(x = x1_, y = y1_, colour = name),
             alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  coord_sf() +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# save the bounding box as a shapefile
pig_subset_aoi %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_write("mapping/pig_subset_aoi_wgs84.geojson", driver = "GeoJSON", delete_dsn = TRUE)

```

## Subset environmental covariates

### AlphaEarth embeddings

```{r}

# load and plot
alphaearth_embeddings <- rast("mapping/feral_pig_aoi_alphaearth_2025.tif")
plot(alphaearth_embeddings)

# crop by the bounding box
alphaearth_embeddings_crop <- crop(alphaearth_embeddings, pig_subset_aoi)
plot(alphaearth_embeddings_crop)

# save the cropped embeddings
writeRaster(alphaearth_embeddings_crop, "mapping/feral_pig_aoi_alphaearth_2025_crop.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

```

# Number of simulated locations per cell

::: {.panel-tabset}

## All locations - no aggregation (20 metre cells)

```{r}

simulated_locations <- rast("outputs/alphaearth/2026-08-17_4/simulated_heatmap_599traj_20m_burnin0.tif")
plot(simulated_locations)

simulated_locations_crop <- terra::crop(simulated_locations, pig_subset_2250_aoi)
water_layer_crop <- terra::crop(water_layer, pig_subset_2250_aoi)

simulated_locations_crop_mask <- terra::mask(simulated_locations_crop, water_layer_crop, maskvalue = 1) 

writeRaster(simulated_locations_crop_mask, "mapping/simulated_heatmap_599traj_20m_burnin0_crop_masked.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

```

## All locations - 2x2 aggregation (40 metre cells)

```{r}

simulation_filename <- "simulated_heatmap_599traj_40m_burnin0_full.tif"
simulated_locations <- rast(paste0("outputs/alphaearth/2026-08-17_4/", simulation_filename))
plot(simulated_locations)

simulated_locations_crop <- terra::crop(simulated_locations, pig_subset_2250_aoi)
water_layer_crop <- terra::crop(water_layer, pig_subset_2250_aoi)

# Resample water_layer onto the same grid as simulated_locations
water_layer_resampled <- terra::resample(water_layer_crop, simulated_locations_crop, method = "near")
# Now mask
simulated_locations_crop_mask <- terra::mask(simulated_locations_crop, water_layer_resampled, maskvalue = 1)

plot(simulated_locations_crop_mask)
plot(log(simulated_locations_crop_mask))

writeRaster(simulated_locations_crop_mask, paste0("mapping/", simulation_filename, "_crop_masked.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(log(simulated_locations_crop_mask), paste0("mapping/", simulation_filename, "_crop_masked_log.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

simulated_locations_full <- simulated_locations_crop_mask

```

## Difference between the wet and dry heatmaps

```{r}

heatmap_diff <- log(simulated_locations_wet) - log(simulated_locations_dry)

# write the raster
# writeRaster(heatmap_diff, "mapping/east_alligator_wet_dry_heatmap_diff.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

# Find the max absolute value so the scale is symmetric around 0
max_abs <- max(abs(minmax(heatmap_diff)), na.rm = TRUE)

# Build a diverging palette: orange -> white -> skyblue
n_cols <- 100
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("orange", "white", "skyblue"))(n_cols)

# Symmetric breaks so white always lands exactly on zero
breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = n_cols + 1)

plot(heatmap_diff, col = pal, breaks = breaks,
     range = c(-max_abs, max_abs))

```

### With ggplot

```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = heatmap_diff) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "orange",
    mid = "white",
    high = "skyblue",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = NA,
    name = "log(wet) -\nlog(dry)"
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("outputs/east_alligator_wet_dry_heatmap_diff.png", 
       width = 250, height = 150, units = "mm", scale = 0.75, dpi = 600)

```

## Connectivity raster

```{r}

betweenness_filename <- "betweenness_599traj_100m_steps10000_full.tif"
betweenness_locations <- rast(paste0("outputs/alphaearth/2026-08-17_4/", betweenness_filename))
plot(betweenness_locations)

betweenness_locations_crop <- terra::crop(betweenness_locations, pig_subset_2250_aoi)
water_layer_crop <- terra::crop(water_layer, pig_subset_2250_aoi)

# Resample water_layer onto the same grid as betweenness_locations
water_layer_resampled <- terra::resample(water_layer_crop, betweenness_locations_crop, method = "near")
# Now mask
betweenness_locations_crop_mask <- terra::mask(betweenness_locations_crop, water_layer_resampled, maskvalue = 1)

plot(betweenness_locations_crop_mask)
plot(log(betweenness_locations_crop_mask))
plot(sqrt(betweenness_locations_crop_mask))

writeRaster(betweenness_locations_crop_mask, paste0("mapping/", betweenness_filename, "_crop_masked.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(log(betweenness_locations_crop_mask), paste0("mapping/", betweenness_filename, "_crop_masked_log.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(sqrt(betweenness_locations_crop_mask), paste0("mapping/", betweenness_filename, "_crop_masked_sqrt.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

```
